high_level_description: The image is a split-screen presentation during what appears to be an academic or professional lecture. The slide lists various daily life activities that can be recognized using smart sensors and AI, including: Infection: Fever, Urinary frequency, Respiratory rate Mobility: Falls (Slowed movements, Unstable transfers), Front door loitering, Immobility Sleep: Sleeping (Day/night reversal) Diet: Eating (Fluid intake, Alcohol consumption, Pill
